classification.difficultyReason: Infer the common sum and coordinate fraction calculations across intersecting rows, columns and diagonals.

content.prompt: Complete the following magic squares, in which each row, column and diagonal must add up to the same sum.

answer.worked:
The complete diagonal gives the common sum:
$$2\frac{1}{2}+1\frac{5}{6}+1\frac{1}{6}=\frac{15+11+7}{6}=5\frac{1}{2}.$$
Subtract the two known entries from this sum, using sixths.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Middle left}&=\frac{33-15-18}{6}=0\\\text{Bottom middle}&=\frac{33-18-7}{6}=1\frac{1}{3}\\\text{Top right}&=\frac{33-11-18}{6}=\frac{2}{3}\\\text{Top middle}&=\frac{33-15-4}{6}=2\frac{1}{3}\\\text{Middle right}&=\frac{33-4-7}{6}=3\frac{2}{3}\end{align*}$$
Each row, column and diagonal totals $5\frac{1}{2}$.

The complete diagonal gives the common sum:
$$2\frac{4}{5}+2\frac{7}{10}+2\frac{3}{5}=\frac{28+27+26}{10}=8\frac{1}{10}.$$
Subtract the two known entries from this sum, using tenths.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Top middle}&=\frac{81-30-28}{10}=2\frac{3}{10}\\\text{Middle left}&=\frac{81-30-26}{10}=2\frac{1}{2}\\\text{Bottom right}&=\frac{81-30-27}{10}=2\frac{2}{5}\\\text{Middle right}&=\frac{81-28-24}{10}=2\frac{9}{10}\\\text{Bottom middle}&=\frac{81-26-24}{10}=3\frac{1}{10}\end{align*}$$
Each row, column and diagonal totals $8\frac{1}{10}$.
